samples.text:
The maps show a regional airport in 2000 and after it was expanded in 2024. Overall, the airport became much bigger, with a second runway and a second terminal, and the farmland is not there anymore.

In 2000, the airport had one terminal in the centre, which was connected to the motorway in the north by a road. There was only one runway in the south and a car park next to the terminal on the east side. There was farmland in the west and in the east of the airport.

In 2024, Terminal 1 and the first runway are still there. However, a second runway has been build to the north of the first one and it is same length. Terminal 2 was built in the west, where was farmland before, and it has a new road to the motorway. Also, the car park changed into a multi-storey car park and a hotel was built next to it. Finally, there is a rail link now which come from the west to a station between the two terminals.
samples.why: Overview present · main developments covered · simple, formulaic linking (Also, Finally) · adequate vocabulary · several errors in verb form, articles, relative clauses and agreement that do not block meaning.

samples.text:
The maps illustrate the expansion of a regional airport between 2000 and 2024. Overall, the airport has grown significantly, gaining a second runway, a second terminal and improved transport links, much of which has been built on land that was previously farmland.

In 2000, the airport was relatively simple. It consisted of Terminal 1 in the centre, linked to the motorway in the north by a short road, a single runway along the south of the site and a car park on the eastern side of the terminal. The land to the west and to the south-east of the terminal was farmland.

By 2024, a second runway had been constructed parallel to the original one and just north of it, running the full width of the site. Terminal 2 has been built on the former farmland in the west and has its own access road from the motorway. In addition, a rail link now runs from the west to a small station located just north of the terminals. On the eastern side, the car park has been redeveloped as a multi-storey car park, and a hotel has been constructed beside it.
samples.why: Clear overview · developments logically sequenced from past to present · good range of linking and reference · appropriate vocabulary (parallel, redeveloped) · mostly error-free with a minor tense inconsistency.

samples.text:
The two maps compare a regional airport in 2000 with the same site following its expansion in 2024. The most significant changes are the doubling of the number of runways and terminals and the addition of a rail connection, with the surrounding farmland disappearing entirely.

In 2000, the airport comprised a single terminal at its centre, reached by a short road from the motorway to the north, together with one runway stretching across the southern part of the site. A car park adjoined the terminal to the east, and farmland covered the land to the west and south-east.

By 2024, a second runway had been laid parallel to the first, slightly further north, while a new terminal, Terminal 2, had been built on the western farmland, served by a separate access road from the motorway. Rail passengers can now reach the airport via a line from the west, which terminates at a small station just north of the terminals. On the eastern side, the original car park has been replaced by a multi-storey facility on the same site, and a hotel now stands immediately to its east. Terminal 1, its access road and the original runway are unchanged.
samples.why: Precise overview of scale and nature of the expansion · key features skilfully selected and compared · seamless cohesion · wide, precise vocabulary (comprised, absorbed, terminates) · wide range of structures, no errors.
